info.title: MyPoGoCompanion API
info.description:
The shared API behind MyPoGoCompanion's web app (and, later, its mobile apps). Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Niantic, Nintendo or The Pokémon Company.

**Signing in:** the web app sends people to Google, then swaps Google's one-time code for our own tokens with `POST /auth/google`. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; it lasts 15 minutes, and `POST /auth/refresh` swaps the refresh token for the next pair.

**Errors** come as problem details (`application/problem+json`) with a `detail` that can be shown to people.

post.summary: Swaps a refresh token for a new access token and the next refresh token (401: sign in again).
post.description: Each refresh token works once. Presenting one that was already swapped ends that sign-in (it was copied), so clients must keep only the latest token and refresh one request at a time.
Always 204, also for a token that is unknown or already ended, so it can be retried safely.

reference.description: The reference the app showed (8 to 32 hex characters, the start of the trace id).

oneOf.description: Whether a screen broke or a script failed.

stack.description: The stack trace, when the browser gives one.

path.description: The app's address where it happened, without the query.

ClientErrorRequest.description: An error in the web app, reported so it can be found in Application Insights.

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the last successful run finished; null when it has never run.

daysSinceUpdate.description: Whole days since then; null when it has never run.

outOfDate.description:
True once DaysSinceUpdate reaches the limit for this kind (3 days for game data, 9 for raids and
events). Never true for data that has never been updated: there is nothing to be out of date.

limitDays.description: The limit for this kind, in days.

DataFreshness.description: When one kind of data was last updated, and whether the app should warn that it is out of date.

EffectiveRole.description: What a user may do: the stored role, or super admin when their email is the configured one.

FamilyMember.description: A version of a species in the family, for the evolution chain and the IV checker.

gameData.description: Pokédex, moves, tier lists, filters: updated by the daily import.

liveData.description: Raid bosses, Max Battles, events, eggs and research: updated by the weekly AI researcher.

FreshnessResponse.description: How up to date the app's data is, per kind of data.

GoogleClientResponse.description: Where the web app sends people to sign in with Google.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE code verifier the web app made before sending the person to Google (43–128 characters).

redirectUri.description: The web app's `/auth/callback` address the person came back to (must be one of the app's addresses).

language.description: The language the device is showing (`en` or `pt-PT`): a new account starts with it.

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Google's answer after the person signed in there, to swap for our own tokens.

version.description: The build that is running (the Git commit in deployed images, "dev" locally).

HealthResponse.description: What `/health` returns. Check details stay in the logs; only their status is public.

LanguageRequest.description: The interface language to save with the account.

name.description: The name from their Google account.

pictureUrl.description: Their Google profile picture, if any.

theme.description: Device (follow the device), Light or Dark.

MeResponse.description: The signed-in user as the web app sees them.

MoveUses.description: A move's number of uses in PvPoke's simulations.

kind.description: Raid, MaxBattle, Egg, Research or Event.

maxStars.description: The Max Battle's stars (Max Battles only).

taskPt.description: The research task in Portuguese; null when missing.

eventNameEn.description: The event it belongs to (or the event itself); null when none.

eventNamePt.description: The event's Portuguese name; null when missing.

oneOf.description: The event's kind; null when no event.

startsAt.description: When it starts (local time); null when not known.

endsAt.description: When it ends (local time); null when open-ended.

shiny.description: Its shiny can be found there.

PageAppearance.description:
One appearance of a version in the live data. Times are the game's local wall-clock times (null when the source
gave none); the app compares them with its own clock.

PageBestIvs.description: The rank-1 IVs in a league.

PageCostume.description: An event costume: its picture's name and a readable name ("Holiday 2022").

candyAfterTrade.description: Candy needed when traded first (free evolutions are 0); null when no discount.

itemId.description: An item needed (`ITEM_SUN_STONE`); null when none.

buddyDistanceKm.description: Kilometres walked as a buddy; null when not needed.

lureId.description: A lure module needed; null when none.

taskEn.description: A special task in English; null when none.

taskPt.description: The task in Portuguese; null when missing.

PageEvolution.description: An evolution step and what it needs.

kind.description: Base, Regional, Mega, Primal, Alternate or Costume.

isDefault.description: The form the page shows first (exactly one per species).

namePt.description: The game's Portuguese name; null when missing.

labelEn.description: Its short label on the version switcher ("Mega"); null for the main form.

labelPt.description: The label in Portuguese; null when missing.

maxCp.description: Max CP with 15/15/15 at levels 40, 50 and 51.

perfectCp.description: The 100% CP cheat sheet: 15/15/15 at levels 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35.

shadow.description: Its Shadow (and so Purified) version is released.

shiny.description: Its shiny is released; null while unknown (the AI researcher fills it).

sprite.description: Its picture's name; null when none.

spriteShiny.description: Its shiny picture's name; null when none.

spriteGigantamax.description: Its Gigantamax picture's name; null when none.

looksOnly.description: Same stats and types as the main form, only a different look.

buddyDistanceKm.description: Walking distance per candy as a buddy.

secondMoveStardust.description: Stardust to unlock a second charged move.

movepool.description: Every move it can have and how (Normal, EliteTm, Legacy).

matchups.description: The damage multiplier of each attacking type against it (GO's chart, no immunities).

pvp.description: PvPoke's ranking per league (and its Shadow), with the recommended moveset and move usage.

bestIvs.description: The rank-1 IVs per league (a tie goes to the higher CP).

raidRanks.description: Its rank in each attacking type's raid list (and its Shadow's).

raidMovesets.description: Every fast + charged combination ranked for raids (and for its Shadow).

PageForm.description: A version of the species with everything the page shows about it.

PageFormMove.description: A move in a form's movepool.

PageKeeperBox.description: The bars (0–4 each) the keeper filters keep in a league.

namePt.description: The game's Portuguese name; null when missing.

raidDurationMs.description: Raid duration in milliseconds; 0 when it has no raid version.

raidEnergy.description: Raid energy gained (fast) or spent (charged, negative).

pvpEnergy.description: PvP energy gained (fast) or spent (charged, negative).

pvpTurns.description: PvP turns of a fast move; null for charged moves.

pvpBuffChance.description: Chance (0–1) of its stat changes; null when none.

pvpSelfAttack.description: Stages added to the user's Attack.

pvpSelfDefense.description: Stages added to the user's Defense.

pvpOpponentAttack.description: Stages added to the opponent's Attack.

pvpOpponentDefense.description: Stages added to the opponent's Defense.

PageMove.description: A move with its raid and PvP numbers.

rank.description: Its place in PvPoke's overall ranking.

chargedMove2Id.description: The recommended second charged move; null when it has only one.

usage.description: How often PvPoke's simulations use each of its moves (fast and charged together; the app splits them).

PagePvpRanking.description: PvPoke's ranking of the form (or its Shadow) in a league.

PageRaidMoveset.description: A fast + charged combination ranked for raids.

PageRaidRank.description: The form's place in an attacking type's raid list, with the moveset it is ranked with.

kind.description: Base, Regional, Mega, Primal, Alternate or Costume.

isDefault.description: The form the line shows when nothing else is asked for (exactly one per species).

nameEn.description: The name to show ("Mega Charizard Y", "Hisuian Arcanine", "Giratina (Origin)").

namePt.description: The game's Portuguese name ("Mega Charizard Y", "Arcanine de Hisui"); null when missing.

labelEn.description: The short text of its marker ("Mega Y", "Hisuian", "Origin"); null for the main form.

labelPt.description: The marker's text in Portuguese ("Mega Y", "Hisui", "Forma Origem"); null when missing.

sprite.description: Its picture's name (`pm6.fMEGA_Y`, served as `/sprites/pm6.fMEGA_Y.webp`); null when none.

spriteGigantamax.description: Its Gigantamax picture's name; null when it can't Gigantamax or has none.

looksOnly.description:
Same stats and types as the main form, only a different look (costumes, Burmy's cloaks, Genesect's drives): no
marker on the list (decision 2026-11-08).

fastMoves.description: Ids of every fast move it can have (Elite TM and Legacy included).

chargedMoves.description: Ids of every charged move it can have (Elite TM and Legacy included).

PokedexForm.description: A version of a species with its own stats, types or picture.

namePt.description: The game's Portuguese name; null when missing.

PokedexMove.description: A move, for the Pokédex search.

moves.description: Every move, for searching by move (`@earthquake`) and by move type (`@fire`).

PokedexResponse.description:
The whole Pokédex in one answer (decision 2026-11-08): every species with its versions and the moves they learn,
only the fields the Pokédex list (B1) and its search use. The app searches, filters and sorts it itself.

namePt.description: The game's Portuguese name; null when the game text lacks it (the app shows the English one).

category.description: Legendary, Mythical, Ultra Beast, or None.

familyId.description: The evolution family (`+pikachu` finds the whole family).

forms.description: Its versions, the main form first, then Megas and Primals, regional forms, other forms and looks-only forms.

PokedexSpecies.description: One Pokédex entry: one line of the list.

namePt.description: The game's Portuguese name; null when missing (the app shows the English one).

category.description: Legendary, Mythical, Ultra Beast, or None.

forms.description: Its versions: the main form first, then Megas and Primals, regional forms, other forms and looks.

keeperBoxes.description: The appraisal bars the keeper filters keep for this Pokédex number (Great and Ultra League).

moves.description: Every move its versions can learn or use, with raid and PvP numbers.

family.description: Every version of every species in its family (Megas left out), for the evolution chain and the IV checker.

evolutions.description: The family's evolution steps with what each needs.

costumes.description: Its event costumes (from PokeMiners' pictures; no dates).

appearances.description:
Where its versions appear or appeared (raids, Max Battles, eggs, research, events), from the live data; the app
tells "right now" from history with its own clock.

cpMultipliers.description: The game's CP multiplier per half level from level 1.

PokemonPageResponse.description:
Everything the Pokémon page (B2) shows for one species, all its versions included, in one answer (decision
2026-11-08): switching versions or tabs needs no new request. The IV rank checker works in the app from the base
stats and IReadOnlyList<double> PokemonPageResponse.CpMultipliers.

refreshToken.description: The latest refresh token from a sign-in or refresh.

publishMissing.description:
"Publish what's missing" (super admin only): publish the rows the sources no longer list, when they are exactly
the ones the last held run showed. Left out: a normal run, which holds again if rows are missing.

execution.description: The job execution's name, to find it in the Azure portal.

startedAt.description: When it was asked to start.

RunImportResponse.description: The run Azure started. The job writes its own run log (job_runs) as soon as it starts.

accessToken.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; keep it in memory only.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: When the access token stops working (15 minutes).

refreshToken.description: Swap it with `POST /auth/refresh`; it works once and lasts 30 days from its last use.

SessionResponse.description: What a sign-in or refresh returns: a 15-minute access token, the next refresh token and the user.

SetRoleRequest.description: The role to give: User (removes admin) or Admin.

TypeMultiplier.description: How much damage an attacking type does to the form (×1.6, ×2.56, ×0.625, ×0.39…).

Bearer.description: The access token from POST /auth/google or POST /auth/refresh (15 minutes).
